definition: The plan record now open in the Plan step: the one house the bench edits, evaluates and draws. Your browser holds it and the server keeps no plan of its own; opening a candidate hands its record to the bench.
basis: docs/workbench.md, the client-owned plan record: "The plan record is a document the browser owns", each edit is evaluated as a request that "carries the whole record back", and "The server holds no plan state." Its routes table: a candidate's plan route "hands one record to the workbench".
